branches.title: Stability Restored
branches.text: The release wards hum in harmony. Your team held the line and kept the gates intact.

branches.title: Chaos Surge
branches.text: A rushed deploy cracked the gate seals. Ganonix gains ground across production.

branches.title: Gate Doctrine Learned
branches.text: You chose the secure order: build, test, scan, review, deploy.

branches.title: Sequence Broken
branches.text: Pipeline order collapsed. Testing and review must come before deployment.

branches.title: Gate of Courage Holds
branches.text: Approval, CI, and security checks aligned. Deployment succeeded with discipline.

branches.title: Gate Denied
branches.text: Deployment was denied by upstream gates. Complete Power and Wisdom first.

branches.title: Ganonix Defeated
branches.text: The Triforce is balanced. Your pipeline now resists shadow deployments.

branches.title: Shadow Resistance
branches.text: Ganonix endures. Recover every gate and return to the final release sequence.
